title: The Roller Rink
survival_class: Devoid of Harmful Entities (first two class items unrendered placeholders {$one}, {$two})
physical_identity: Infinitely looping roller rink with arcade, food court, skate rental and cinema; wooden rink floor, colourful dimmed lights, pop music.
scale_topology: Looping interior; rink is largest; arcade east; cinema north; food court small; indoor; single level.
lighting_sound: Colourful fluorescents, star fixture, usually dimmed; muffled radio pop, skates, laughter, arcade noise.

entities.name: Facelings (general)
entities.behavior: Docile employees or lone customers; wander, play arcade games, converse in food court and Cinema.

entities.name: Food court Faceling
entities.behavior: Blank name tag, serves free food, cleans up, refuses to answer questions about the Backrooms.

entities.name: DJ Faceling
entities.behavior: Occasionally seen inside the south DJ station selecting songs.

entities.name: The Coach
entities.behavior: Native Faceling; friendly, smart; lessons, remembers names, leads wanderers out.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Facelings, The Coach
items_communities: Free food and soda, almond water

entrances.method: wooden door with music playing behind it
entrances.quote: wooden door in Level 2 or Level 3 that has music playing on the other side

entrances.from: Unnamed level with brick electrical station
entrances.method: wooden door within brick walls of a forgotten electrical station
entrances.quote: the wooden door within the brick walls of a long-forgotten electrical station

exits.method: noclip into any working arcade game
exits.conditions: working game in the arcade portion
exits.quote: No-clipping into any working game in the arcade portion will transport one to Level 40

exits.conditions: must be found; diary places it in a back arcade area with covered machines
exits.quote: a white door in this level with the number 70 engraved on it

exits.method: door labelled "Employees only!" in the food court
exits.conditions: diary claims people who enter do not return
exits.quote: a door labeled "Employees only!" in the food court will send you to Level 232

exits.method: the Coach leads you to an exit if asked
exits.conditions: ask the Coach; automatic after a prolonged stay
exits.quote: The Coach will then attempt to lead you to an exit

signature_mechanic: Comfort trap: free food, games, skates and music keep wanderers; the Coach pushes them to leave before familiarity turns to apathy.
verticality: None; cinema benches in a small stepped fashion.
do_not: Do not add hostile entities; class is 'Devoid of Harmful Entities'.

conflicts_notes: Diary says the Coach 'failed to help' others (TESTIMONY). Closing note says Liminal Echo is suspected but unknown. Link list includes Levels 30 and 32 not in body.
